title: DIY Procreate Watercolor. Sunflowers
author: LetsArtShop
description:
I am very happy to introduce you to my new Procreate kit collection concept as DIY: paint with me with a special awesome Procreate kit series. 
DIY Procreate kit series: watercolor flowers cards. Draw Sunflowers included:
• 2 PSD file for drawing in Procreate(or used like a coloring page) with watercolor paper background texture, 9″x12″, 300 dpi. File included reference image.
• 4 brushes with watercolor texture: Honey watercolor brush, Lettering smooth brush, background tone brush, soft pencil for drawing details.
• 1 color swatches for Procreate
• 2 video tutorial step by step drawing on my Youtube channel:
You can write a comment or ask a questions.
• 2 guide step-by-step drawing in JPG format
Create your awesome greeting card for printing or send on email or social media with You can use #letsart_Procreate_DIY in Instagram publications
You will receive: 2 PSD file, 1 brushset file (NOTE: for Procreate version 4.0 or earlier brushset is not available), 1 swatches
Happy drawing )
How Installing Procreate Brushes (.brush and brushset)
Use this option if you have an older iPad or Procreate version 4.0 or earlier. Here’s how:
1.	Download folder .brush file to your folder on your iPad
2.	Open the folder and choose .brush files
3. Tap and hold with your finger or apple pencil
4. Choose “Share” from the menu
5. If the option “Open in Procreate” is missing, click on “More”
6. Scroll and find the option “Open in Procreate” and click on it
7. Open your project in Procreate and click on brush icon at the top right corner
Or
1.	Open Procreate, click new collection – brush – import
2.	Find folder with download brush, choose it, added in Procreate.
